versions.changelog:
Initial release of the engineering hiring rubric skill.

- Generates comprehensive engineering hiring rubrics and technical interview scorecards tailored to role, level, team context, and tech stack.
- Provides behavioral question banks, technical questions with explicit evaluation criteria, and system design rubrics.
- Produces a structured interview loop and debrief agenda, highlighting consistent, bias-resistant candidate evaluation.
- Includes calibration notes to help interviewers counter common evaluation biases and align on scoring.
- Ensures each competency is assessed by at least two independent interviews for reliability.
